data: 台風[たいふう]で ２[に] 河川[かせん]が 氾濫[はんらん] し そうになっている。
Due to the typhoon, two rivers are getting close to overflowing.
Counter,Somewhat Common
河川 · かせん · Rivers (formal). For regular or casual situations, it's okay to use 本 to count rivers.
倉庫[そうこ]には パイプ 椅子[いす]が ５０[ごじゅう]脚[きゃく] しまってある。
There are fifty steel chairs stored in the storehouse.
Counter,Somewhat Common
脚 · きゃく · Pieces of furniture with long-ish legs, including chairs, tables, desks, wine glasses, horseshoes, legs, etc.
その 1[いち]報[ほう]に、 誰[だれ]もが 驚[おどろ]きを 隠[かく]せませんでした。
No one could hide their surprise at that news.
Counter,Somewhat Common
報 · ほう · Reports, news, and information.
みかん １[いち] 籠[かご] ２９８[にひゃくきゅうじゅうはち]円[えん]なの？ じゃあ、 ３[さん] 籠[かご] ください。
Is a basket of oranges ¥298? If so, I'd like three baskets, please.
Counter,Somewhat Common
籠 · かご · Baskets and/or piles of whatever is inside a basket.
1[いち] 親等[しんとう]の 親族[しんぞく]って、 通常[つうじょう]は 誰[だれ]の ことを 指[さ]すんですか？
Which relatives are generally considered to be in the first degree of kinship?
Counter,Somewhat Common

親等 · しんとう · Degrees of relation or kinship between relatives. In Japan, you and your spouse are considered 0親等, your parents and children are 1親等, your siblings, grandparents, and grandchildren are 2親等, aunts, uncles, nieces, nephews, great-grandparents and great-grandchildren are 3親等, first cousins are 4親等, and on from there.
あの お相撲[すもう]さんは、 ちゃんこ鍋[なべ] 1[いち] 鍋[なべ]を 一人[ひとり]で 全部[ぜんぶ] 平[たい]らげた。
That sumo wrestler ate up a whole nabe pot of chanko alone.
Counter,Somewhat Common
鍋 · なべ · Nabe pots.

I bought all thirty-two volumes of One Piece.
Counter,Common

巻 · かん · Series of books, videotapes, cassette tapes, etc. It can also be used as an ordinal number suffix to show which item in a series it is. For example, ハリーポッターの１３巻目 is "the thirteenth Harry Potter book in the series."
今日[きょう]は 鯛[たい]が １[いち] 柵[さく]も 無[な]いんですよ。
We don't have a single block of sea bream today.
Counter,Somewhat Common
柵/冊 · さく · Strips or blocks of fish, rows of a stadium, rows of a concert hall, rows of an auditorium, etc.
パセリ 1[いち] 掴[つか]みって どれぐらいの 量[りょう]かな。
I wonder how much a handful of parsley is.
Counter,Somewhat Common
掴み · つかみ · Grabbable portions, handfuls of things.
ジャマルは 1[いち]振[ふ]りで スイカを 叩[たた]き割[わ]った。
Jamal smashed a watermelon in one swing.
Counter,Somewhat Common
振り · ふり · Swings, sprinkles, shakes and more.
同[おな]じ 食器[しょっき]の セット、 2[に] 揃[そろ]いも 買[か]って どう するの？
Why are you buying two complete sets of the same tableware?
Counter,Somewhat Common
揃い · そろい · Sets of items with two or more matching pieces : chopsticks, futon sets, bedding sets, suits, tea sets, utensil sets.
